end.summary:
Practised circle parts: radius, chord, diameter, arc, segment, and sector.
Identified radius as centre-to-edge and diameter as a straight line through the centre.
Identified chord and arc as the boundaries of a segment.
Used pizza-slice and cut-piece examples for sector and segment; sector/segment confusion remained once.
Teach-back on the definitions was not passed.
end.parentNote: Dev practised naming circle parts and used everyday examples to distinguish a sector from a segment. They correctly described radius, diameter, and the boundaries of a segment; the sector-versus-segment mix-up was not corrected after it last appeared. At home, ask Dev to label a circle and explain each part using a pizza slice for a sector and a cut-off piece for a segment.
